diagnosis: The checks C1, C2, C4, C5, and C6 were satisfied without the hidden information because the lone decision-maker used default values and common heuristics. Specifically, the settlement in all rollouts defaulted to standard procedures for loading controls (C1), did not require export licenses or ECCN invoices (C4), and used a balanced split between rail and truck shipments (C5). The model likely applied these common practices without needing the detailed private facts provided by PF1, PF2, and PF3.
